security.rule: Every private/customer or staff task requires verified Auth subject and case/role scope, not user_metadata.
Data classes are LOGICAL PROPOSALS, not claims about existing SQL tables or API endpoints.
Personal module capability + case assignment + MFA AAL2 + audit; no automatic private Storage object disclosure.
Official IND or judiciary submission requires legally competent operator and actual institution receipt.
Payment, refund and payout are not confirmed by UI; only actual PSP/provider + two-person authorization.
Six locale legal/native QA, date/source and publication consent; never invent eight missing checklist slugs.
L3 design approval does not authorize L4 code, live SQL/production release, or independent acceptance.
